name: Kozuka Seira
source:
Class: Year 3, Rose Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Splendid Lady." As her title suggests, Seira is a smart and good-natured girl who always has a smile on her face. She gets along with everyone and is adored by both her classmates and underclassmen. While she is popular with her peers, in reality she has no friends, and her smile masks her ruthless true nature, which is always ready to discard those she deems "useless."

She has a huge sweet tooth and especially loves eating parfaits.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
